mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCTID AS productId, CATEGORY AS categoryId, NAME, DESCN AS description FROM PRODUCT ORDER BY PRODUCTID
SELECT PRODUCTID AS productId, CATEGORY AS categoryId, NAME, DESCN AS description FROM PRODUCT WHERE CATEGORY = #{categoryId} ORDER BY PRODUCTID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT (PRODUCTID, CATEGORY, NAME, DESCN) VALUES (#{productId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET CATEGORY = #{categoryId}, NAME = #{name}, DESCN = #{description} WHERE PRODUCTID = #{productId}
